messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 500 rate on /v1/embeddings (eu-west-1). Error spike started ~1712345600, current err% 18% over 5m. Paging on-call.
Emma: On it. I'm the primary oncall. Pulling logs + routing table now.
Raj: I saw the pager. Repro locally hitting eu-west -> embed route gets a chat model binary and 500s. Investigating fallback policy.
Lena: Noted — we recently pushed a routing alias change for 'embed-base' in eu-west for staging -> prod promotion, can you include config id?
Emma: Grabbed the policy: policy id rk-9923. Alias 'embed-base' pinned to variant 'chat-v2-eu' (incorrect). Expected 'embed-flash-v1'. That explains type mismatch (embeddings request -> chat model handler).
Noah: How did that pin get applied? deployment tool logs?
DeployBot: deploy/alias-update rk-9923 by lena @1712345012 — changed alias embed-base -> chat-v2-eu (reason: shortcut for chat rollout). Command: POST /api/aliases/rk-9923 {"alias":"embed-base","variant":"chat-v2-eu"}
Emma: Oof. That looks like human error. This is production alias pointed at wrong variant.
Maria: Support: We have 3 open high-sev customer tickets (CUST-1448, CUST-1451, CUST-1454) reporting 500s for embedding endpoints in EU. Notified affected customers via incident status page.
Alice-CS: Customers seeing timeouts in their embedding pipeline; one customer has batch job failing and blocking downstream analytics.
Raj: Temporary mitigation plan: rollback alias to previous variant, and add compat-fallback rule so embed requests falling back to a compatible variant instead of chat.
Lena: I can rollback the alias now. Executing:

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/aliases/rk-9923/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Lena: Rollback API accepted. Changing live config...
Emma: Adding a policy-level emergency override to route embedding content-type to 'embed-flash-v1' in eu-west until we finish postmortem.

```
PATCH /api/routing/policies/urgent-override
{ "match": {"content_type":"embedding","region":"eu-west-1"}, "route_to":"embed-flash-v1", "ttl":300 }
```

DeployBot: policy update accepted @1712345732
Emma: Monitoring traffic. Error rate dropping -> 3% now. Latency normalizing.
Raj: Verified with logs. Before fix we saw stack trace: "TypeError: model does not support embed request -> handler 'chat_generate' returned 400" and lots of 500s. After fix, embed handler responses resumed.
Maria: Updating customers: posted ETA ~15m for mitigation and follow-up postmortem.
Noah: Root cause hypotheses: 1) manual alias change intended for chat rollout used global alias name 'embed-base' by mistake; 2) lack of pre-deploy validation to detect incompatible variant types for an alias used by embeddings route.
Emma: Immediate actions:
- Re-pin alias to correct variant (done)
- Add a guard in alias update UI/API to reject mismatched model types for alias tags used in prod routes
- Notify product + deploy owners

Raj: Longer term:
- Add a routing policy validator that checks content_type compatibility during alias changes
- Add canary check: small % traffic for 5m with schema type checks
- Add audit trail alert when alias points to variant with different capability tags
Lena: Filing PR for API-side guard now. Linking to thread.

```
PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821
```

Emma: Incident status -> MONITORED. No further customer escalations in last 20m. Preparing incident channel update for 1hr and schedule postmortem owner.
Noah: Assigning postmortem to Lena + Raj. Add severity P2 (customer-facing failures but mitigated quickly).
Maria: I'll follow up with customers and include timeline + workaround.
Alice-CS: Thx team, customers appreciate the rapid response.
Emma: Closing active page. Leave this thread open for the postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved for alert id alert-eu-9923 at 1712345810. Summary: Mis-pinned alias caused embeddings->chat routing in eu-west; rollback and emergency policy restored correct routing.
